audit.why: Lane difficulty is genuinely EVEN at 55.24% over 963 games: Katarina owns levels 1-5 against Azir's worst-in-class base stats and expensive Conquering Sands (70/80/90/100/110 mana), then loses the matchup from first item onward as soldier range and Emperor's Divide take over.
audit.corrected: Early lane Katarina, side lane and teamfights Azir. Snowball window is levels 3-6 only.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read Skill for Levels 1-3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items while the content layer read Katarina/Katarina/Azir/Azir and the packet chart read Katarina x5 then Azir x2. Two layers rendered different answers.
audit.why: Katarina's real spike is Level 3 (Shunpo online) through Level 6 Death Lotus; Azir's is his first item, where soldier DPS out-ranges the gap-close, and 2+ items where Emperor's Divide gates every entry. The content layer and packet agree; the full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side -> Katarina, phases[5..6].side -> Azir, with ratings and whys moved in the same proposal to match. win[0..6] already holds the correct values on disk, so no content-layer chart edit is required.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Emperor's Divide knocking Katarina back and cancelling the Death Lotus channel — was never stated. breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown number at all, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Katarina's R carries the 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it' flag; Azir's R is a knockback that creates terrain. That single interaction decides every fight after level 6, and its cooldown (120/105/90) versus hers (75/60/45) is the whole timing question. Shifting Sands at 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 is the other real number: it is his only escape and shields him on the dash.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Shifting Sands 22s->16s, Emperor's Divide 120/105/90 and Conquering Sands down to 6s at rank 5; the R-cancels-R interaction is stated in dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t, breakdown.late and phases[6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Shifting Sands is the punishable cooldown early — 22s at rank 1 against Katarina's 12s Shunpo, so a burned E leaves a window of roughly twenty seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave named 'a CC mage's tower' — placeholder phrasing with no Azir content.
audit.why: The real wave problem is Conquering Sands at 740 range poking you off last hits under his tower.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around soldier expiry and the 740-range poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Katarina's Q carries a 'grounding' derived flag in the kit file that contradicts Riot's own description (the dagger bounces and ricochets to the ground; nothing in the text grounds anyone).
audit.why: Per the brief's own rule, when a derived flag contradicts the description, trust the description. The old dosFull[0].t said 'Trade through grounded daggers only', which would have taught a reader that Katarina denies Shifting Sands. She does not.
audit.corrected: Title changed to 'Trade only through landed daggers' and no grounding claim is made anywhere.
